file.description: Path relative to the review root.

line.description: 1-based line number where the verbatim evidence sits, as a string.

dimension.description: Canonical dimension name from the supplied catalogue.

self_proving.description: True when the quoted evidence alone demonstrates the defect.

evidence.description: Verbatim source line or snippet at `line`.

body.description: One line: the issue, why it matters, and the fix.

validation_effort.description: 0 = self-proving (1 read); 3 = one neighbour read; 6 = cross-file tracing (4 reads).

suppressed_reason.description: Set only on a demoted judgment call; null otherwise.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete inputs or state, then the wrong output, crash or leak. Not 'this could be null'.

reversibility.description: Does shipping it make the fix more expensive later (data migration, public contract, a non-native pattern others copy)? Judge the cost of undoing, not the urgency.

idiomatic_fix.description: The framework- or repo-native form, when it differs from the smallest fix in `body`; name what the small patch leaves behind. Null when the two coincide.
